title: Tailwise Training Admission Standards for Enrolling a Dog
content:
A dog enrolled in a Tailwise Training course or pack meets the course's admission standards. Every age in these standards is the dog's age at the first session.

## Standards

**(a) Age.** The dog must be between the course's youngest and oldest age at the first session. An oldest age of 0 means no upper limit.

**(b) Behaviour.** The dog must carry a behaviour flag in the course's accepted behaviour flags. Dogs flagged handling caution or muzzle required train privately.

**(c) Prerequisite course.** The dog must have completed the course's prerequisite course or passed a trainer evaluation.

**(d) Rabies.** When the course requires rabies and the dog is 16 weeks or older at the first session, the dog's rabies expiry date is later than the last scheduled session date.

**(e) Group vaccinations.** Group formats also need a current core vaccine (DHPP or the age-appropriate puppy series) and bordetella where the course requires them.

**(f) Enrollment closing.** Enrollment closes the course's enrollment cutoff, in days, before the first session, or when the class size ceiling is reached.

**(g) Intact dogs.** Intact dogs older than the course's intact-dog age limit in months are not admitted to group classes. A limit of 0 means no limit.

The age range, accepted flags, prerequisite course, which vaccinations are required, the cutoff, the class size ceiling and the intact-dog limit are each course's own figures in the Tailwise Training admission chart and course catalog.

## The rabies standard in detail

| Element | What it is |
|---|---|
| Applies when | The course requires rabies and the dog is 16 weeks or older at the first session |
| Evidence | The rabies expiry date held on the dog's own pet record, the dog being the one enrolled |
| Compared with | The date of the course's last scheduled session |
| Test | The rabies expiry date is later than that date |
| Timing | Judged before the enrollment is made |

Because the test is "later than", a rabies expiry date falling on the very day of the last scheduled session does not meet it.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

A dog aged 18 weeks at the first session of a course that requires rabies, the course's last scheduled session falling on a given day.

| Rabies expiry date on the dog's record | Later than the last scheduled session date? | Standard (d) |
|---|---|---|
| The day after the last scheduled session | Yes | Met |
| The same day as the last scheduled session | No | Not met |
| The day before the last scheduled session | No | Not met |

## Reading the other standards together

- **Format and behaviour.** A dog flagged handling caution or muzzle required trains privately; standard (b) is judged against the accepted flags of the course chosen.
- **Group-only standards.** Standards (e) and (g) are framed for group formats and group classes.
- **Prerequisite.** Where a course names a prerequisite course, standard (c) is met by completing that course or by passing a trainer evaluation; where it names none, there is nothing to complete.
- **Closing.** Standard (f) closes enrollment on whichever of its two events comes first: the cutoff before the first session, or the class reaching its size ceiling.

## Worked example (hypothetical dog)

Hypothetical inputs: a group course that requires rabies, the core vaccine and bordetella, sets a youngest age of 21 weeks and no oldest age, accepts dogs with no behaviour flag, names no prerequisite course and admits intact dogs up to 12 months; a spayed 2-year-old dog with no behaviour flag, a current DHPP and bordetella and a rabies expiry date three months after the course's last scheduled session; enrollment made before the cutoff while the class has room.

Judgement: (a) is met, the dog being older than the youngest age with no oldest age set; (b) is met, the dog carrying no flag, which the course accepts; (c) is met, there being no prerequisite course; (d) is met, the dog being 16 weeks or older and its rabies expiry date later than the last scheduled session date; (e) is met, both vaccinations being current; (f) is met, enrollment not having closed; and (g) does not bar the dog, which is not intact.
